m.d: A gas or liquid, normally water, which has been frozen (made solid)
m.e: When water is cooled below 0°C, it freezes into ice.

m.d: If you ice something, you cool it by putting ice or something else very cold on it.
m.e: I iced my knee after I hurt it in soccer.

m.d: If you ice a cake, you cover with icing.
If you ice someone, you murder them.
If something is icy it is covered with ice.
m.e: Be careful, the sidewalk is icy.

m.d: Iceland is an island country in the northern Atlantic Ocean. Iceland is halfway between Europe and North America.
An image, picture, or other representation of something.
A religious painting that is often done on wooden panels.
A person or thing that is the best example of something.
m.e: That man is an icon in the business; he is loyal and has good business sense.

m.d: An iceberg is a very large piece of ice floating in the sea
If something (a phenomenon or an event) has once become famous, it is iconic.
An icebox is a box that contains ice.
An icebox is a container in a refrigerator.
Icelandic is a language spoken by around 330 thousand people, mainly in Iceland.
If someone is an Icelandic, he or she is from Iceland.
If something is Icelandic, it is about Iceland or the people living there.
